_comment: SEARCH COMPLETENESS for an ACTIVATION's draw: a card Niv-Mizzet, the Firemind's '{T}: Draw a card' draws must be castable the same phase. Post-combat frame (resume_at main2, the last main of the last turn the fixture plays): an untapped, not-sick Firemind, one Mountain, empty hand, Lightning Bolt on top; opponent at 4. The only kill this turn is tap -> draw the Bolt (its draw pings: 3) -> cast the Bolt off the Mountain (0). The draw happens OUTSIDE any cast's window, so only the section-level hand-entry breakpoint (MTG_BP_HAND_ENTRY) lets the plan re-decide on it. Fails if that breakpoint stops seeing an activation's draw or the ping stops resolving before the re-solve.
